business_question: How skewed is order Product GMV?
finding_statement: Order Product GMV was right-skewed: mean BRL 137.42, median BRL 86.90, P99 BRL 995.02.

business_question: What is the full observed frequency distribution?
finding_statement: Customers with one eligible order represented 96.96% of observed commercial customers; maximum frequency was 16.

business_question: How concentrated is observed customer Product GMV?
finding_statement: Median observed customer Product GMV was BRL 89.89; the top 10% accounted for 41.13%.

business_question: What repeat activity is observable after first observed purchase?
finding_statement: Across eligible complete-period cohorts with observable follow-up, mean observed return rates were 0.49% at month 1, 0.34% at month 2, and 0.26% at month 3.
limitation: Unweighted cohort mean; right censoring and prior history unknown

finding_statement: Classic RFM was NOT_RECOMMENDED: Frequency equaled one for 96.96% of customers and could not form five natural quantile bins without tie-breaking.
limitation: Bounded history and partial final month

business_question: How dispersed is delivery lead time?
finding_statement: The governed mean was 12.56 days versus a diagnostic median of 10.22; P95 was 29.27 days.
limitation: Mean KPI unchanged; long observations retained

business_question: How do review distributions differ by delivery outcome?
finding_statement: Late reviewed orders averaged 2.57 versus 4.29 for on-time reviewed orders; score distributions differ descriptively.
